notes.content: Fixed bug which caused audio to not be read by program properly

Fixed scene were sprites would become stuck on other sprites
Fixed game freezing bug during ending

Fixed error where the bathroom quest would start when it was said that it did not
Fixed point where the game would freeze indefinitely due to collisions

Fixed error where game would not start due to improper push in 1.05
Fixed Devon's turn counter, skills will now properly alternate

notes.title: 1.04 update notes
notes.content:
Black Screen fix
-Added missing assets which caused the game to black screen indefinitely at certain points
-Allows people to, you know, play the game

Skills Backend fix
-Updated null checks for number of skills
-Increases performance when opening skills menu in battle (less performance drop)
-While has never caused a recorded error, removes chance of ever causing one 
-Updated turn counter for skills
-Several skills that involved turn counters now function properly
